posts.title: 🔐 Go makes it easy to respond to the eMudhra certificate issue
posts.description: The recent eMudhra certificate issue increases the possibility of a man-in-the-middle attack on IoT devices. On a Linux-based edge device, updating the ca-certificates package fixes this, but a system update can take time to roll out.
